race.description: Ladbrokes Pakenham Cup Day 12 December Hcp (Bm66)
race.comment: Tough race. MOUNT SABYINYO (3) has found one better at his past three but is racing well and finds a winnable affair. Bumped into the progressive Hedjet at Cranbourne last start, he'll be up on speed and hard to run down. UNTAPPED (2) doesn't win out of turn but is going well, sixth in a great form race at Geelong two back before just finding one better at Ballarat. Suited to a mile now and will take holding out. ALEXANDER THEGREAT (4) is lightly raced off a narrow BM56 win at Mornington and can measure up. CHILLIES (8) resumes having run well in some handy staying 3yo contests last time in, he can run well fresh. CAELIUS (6) was below best last time when drifted back and never threatened, finishing 17th over 2000m at Flemington. Expect an improved run here.
